subject: simdata is not simulating all response categories

messages.author: 6096f5087826f400
messages.subject: simdata is not simulating all response categories
parts:
Hello All,

I am performing research using the TIMMS 2019 math and science cognitive items. I have subset the data to focus on the polytomous scored items. Some items only have 3 scoring options while others have 4.  

My plan was the use the obtained item parameters after fitting a GPCM to the TIMMS data as the "true" parameters and pass these as inputs into simdata to begin my study.

However, when I simulate the data I lose a partial credit category. This can be seen below in the comparison between the "true" parameters and the simulated parameters after fitting a GPCM. I provided the slope-intercept formatted parameters below obtained using IRTpars = F





I believe this is due to the sparseness in the response matrix (> 84% missing per item). The category response curves are below

I'd appreciate any assistance with this. For my research I need all the possible responses simulated.

- Yale Quan

parts:
Hi Phil,

Attached is the public dataset and the code is below:

# Fit GPCM Model to Math Data

GPCM_math = mirt(data = TIMMS_math_items,
                 model = 1,
                 itemtype="gpcm",
                 SE=T,
                 technical=list(NCYCLES=2000))

# Extract item parameters
param_math = mirt::coef(GPCM_math, IRTpars=T, simplify=T)$items

# Simulate theta
theta = rnorm(n = 16624,
              mean = 0,
              sd = 1)

# Create MIRT formatted parameters

math_a = as.matrix(param_math[,1])
math_b = as.matrix(param_math[,c(2,3,4)])
math_d = as.vector(-math_a)*math_b

# Run the simulation
math_simdata = as.data.frame(simdata(a = math_a,
                                     d = math_d,
                                     itemtype = "gpcm",
                                     Theta = theta)
)

# Fit GPCM Model to check parameter estimates
GPCM_math_sim = mirt(data = math_simdata,
                 model = 1,
                 itemtype="gpcm",
                 SE=T,
                 technical=list(NCYCLES=2000))

# Compare "true" and simulated parameters
param_math_sim_slopeint = mirt::coef(GPCM_math_sim, IRTpars=F, simplify=T)$items
param_math_slopeint = mirt::coef(GPCM_math, IRTpars=F, simplify=T)$items

Thank you,

- Yale Quan

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: simdata is not simulating all response categories
parts:
The line

math_d = as.vector(-math_a)*math_b

doesn't seem to match the slope-intercept version of mirt's output

mirt::coef(GPCM_math)

so the translation formula is incorrect. You might have some luck looking through the mirt2traditional() function to see the correct transformation, or just use the output from coef() when simulating the data. Sorry for the late reply.

Phil
